svg.title: Queen MQ: one ordered lane per entity, magnified to show acknowledgement, replay, leases and the storage engine
svg.desc: A field of six lanes, one per session, each a rail with a cursor and a backlog. One lane is stalled behind a slow consumer and holds up nobody. The last lane is bracketed and magnified below into ten numbered messages: four complete, three leased, three waiting, and one arriving from a push. A cursor marks the committed offset between message 19 and message 20. Three panels hang off that spine: consumer groups replaying from a segment edge, a leased message resolving to a retry or to the dead-letter table, and a window state, an output message and the acknowledgement of the source committing together. Underneath, three identical broker processes with nothing drawn between them feed one PostgreSQL boundary holding the partition, segment, consumer and dead-letter tables.
